title: Sugarcane Farmers Block Highways Across Karnataka for Higher Prices

tea.why: Sugarcane farmers are protesting because their recent meeting with union ministers in Delhi failed to yield an immediate price decision.
tea.want: Farmers want an increased Minimum Support Price, higher Fair and Remunerative Prices, and Swaminathan Commission recommendations.
tea.changed: Oct 15: Officials met protesters on a padayatra in Belagavi while farmers called for picketing at sugar mills.

summary: Sugarcane farmers initiated multi-district highway blockades across Karnataka, including Belagavi, Bagalkot, Vijayapura, and Dharwad, to demand better pricing for their crops and the implementation of the Swaminathan Commission recommendations. The protests caused significant traffic disruptions on major routes such as the Pune-Bengaluru National Highway. Demonstrations were led by farmer organizations and figures like Hasiru Sene and farmer leader Chunappa Pujeri. Protest activities included blocking toll plazas, check-posts, and laying down in front of vehicles. Authorities, including Union Food Minister Pralhad Joshi, appealed to farmers to withdraw their agitation. Later in the week, district officials and police commissioners met protesters on a padayatra in Belagavi to receive memoranda and urge peaceful demonstrations, while farmers announced plans to picket sugar mills and march toward Hubballi.
demands: Determine a higher Fair and Remunerative Price
Stop sugar sales for less than 60 rupees per kg
response: Union Food Minister Pralhad Joshi appealed to farmers to withdraw the agitation and assured that the Centre would address their concerns. Deputy Commissioner Mohammad Roshan and Police Commissioner Prakash Nikam met the protesters, assured them their concerns would be conveyed, and urged peaceful protests.

updates.text: Sugarcane farmers blocked national highways in districts including Belagavi, Bagalkot, Vijayapura, and Dharwad.
Deputy Commissioner and Police Commissioner met protesters on a padayatra in Belagavi and received a memorandum.
